answer: Distinct-counterparty diversity stops cheap alias farming. An alias earns full pay only after completing work for 8 different verified clients over 14 days, so a cluster trading only among its own copies never qualifies. A zenith client publishes each completed job, and a cedar audit sample re-checks one job per alias each week. An alias whose quartz record shows jobs routed only through the same small circle loses its earnings for 20 epochs and every linked copy is barred with it.
